title: Library entry stocked only elsewhere is hidden when it matches an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • You can also switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL LIBMATCH Loc).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBMATCH-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL LIBMATCH), is tracked at {Location-A} and is inactive.
  • Part number {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST.PL.LIBMATCH.01) is stocked only at {Location-B}, with description {Description-A}; it equals {Part-A} once upper and lower case, hyphens and periods are ignored.
  • Part number {Number-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBOTHER-01) is stocked only at {Location-B}, with description {Description-A}, and matches nothing at {Location-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) at {Location-A} is open and has an approved line, {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL LIBMATCH line"), that holds no parts.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A} open {Work-order-1}.
  2. On {Line-1} open the ⋮ menu and click "Request part".
  3. Type {Description-A} in Part Number.
  4. Close the dialog with ×.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Neither {Part-A} nor a "Part Library" row for {Number-A} is offered. {Number-B} is still offered as a "Part Library" row, which shows the search reached the Part Library.
  • Step 4: {Line-1} holds no parts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-R15, S12-R10, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 6.1 and 6.2 (the Part Library row beside the inventory row), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R15: “A Part Library entry with no part stocked at this location is not offered in the lookups of S9-R1 to S9-R8 when its number matches an inactive part at this location.”
  • PRD Story 9 context note: “in S9-R9a, S9-R15, S9-R16 and S9-R17 a number "matches" an inactive part when the two are the same once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored. A number that also belongs to an active part at this location is not refused.”
  • S12-R10: “A part lookup result that comes from the shared list shows its source as "Part Library".”
